question: What is Nexus AI Lab?
answer: Nexus AI Lab is a unified enterprise artificial intelligence platform combining multilingual translation (LinguaFlow), intelligent FAQ automation (FAQMind), and real-time computer vision tracking (VisionTrack) into a single cohesive workspace.
keywords: nexus ai lab platform overview features unified

question: How do I get started with Nexus AI Lab?
answer: You can get started by selecting your desired AI module from the sidebar: LinguaFlow for language translation, FAQMind for intelligent assistance, or VisionTrack for video object analytics.
keywords: get started quickstart launch navigation setup

question: Who created Nexus AI Lab and is it for CodeAlpha?
answer: Nexus AI Lab was designed and developed specifically for the CodeAlpha Artificial Intelligence Internship project suite, adhering to all official task requirements.
keywords: codealpha internship creator author submission project

question: What languages does LinguaFlow support?
answer: LinguaFlow supports over 30 global languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Russian, and more with auto-detection capabilities.
keywords: lingua flow languages translation auto detect supported

question: How do I translate text in LinguaFlow?
answer: To translate text, type or paste your text into the source text area, select your target language from the dropdown, and click 'Translate Now' or press Ctrl + Enter.
keywords: translate text input how to use linguaflow

question: How does automatic language detection work in LinguaFlow?
answer: LinguaFlow uses an intelligent NLP language identification pipeline to analyze text structure, character n-grams, and word frequencies to determine the source language automatically.
keywords: auto detection source language n-gram nlp

question: Can I export translation history from LinguaFlow?
answer: Yes, LinguaFlow allows you to copy translated outputs to clipboard, search through previous translations, and export translation sessions as text (.txt) files.
keywords: export translation history copy download txt

question: Does LinguaFlow support speech input and voice playback?
answer: Yes, LinguaFlow integrates browser-native Speech-to-Text for voice input and Text-to-Speech synthesis with BCP-47 language voice matching for accurate audio playback.
keywords: speech to text text to speech voice mic audio playback pronunciation

question: How does the FAQMind chatbot answer questions?
answer: FAQMind cleans and tokenizes user input, generates TF-IDF feature vectors, and computes cosine similarity against our knowledge base to deliver accurate responses with confidence scores.
keywords: faqmind chatbot tf-idf cosine similarity matching algorithm

question: What happens when FAQMind has low confidence in an answer?
answer: When the similarity confidence score falls below the configured threshold, FAQMind provides the closest matching answer along with helpful related FAQ topic suggestions.
keywords: low confidence fallback threshold suggestions unknown query

question: Can administrators add, edit, or delete FAQs in FAQMind?
answer: Yes, administrators can use the Knowledge Base Admin tab to add, edit, or delete FAQs. The NLP vector index automatically rebuilds upon any modification.
keywords: admin add edit delete faq management rebuild index

question: How are unmatched chatbot questions handled?
answer: Questions that receive low confidence scores are logged into the Unmatched Queries database table for administrator review and knowledge base expansion.
keywords: unmatched questions analytics logging knowledge base expansion

question: What computer vision model does VisionTrack use?
answer: VisionTrack utilizes pretrained YOLO object detection coupled with an optimized Euclidean centroid object tracking algorithm to provide real-time detection boxes and unique tracking IDs.
keywords: visiontrack yolo object detection tracking centroid model

question: Why does object detection detect multiple bounding boxes or objects?
answer: Deep learning models analyze full video frames for all trained COCO object classes (people, chairs, cars, laptops, etc.). You can increase the Confidence Threshold slider (e.g. to 60-70%) to filter out background objects.
keywords: multiple objects bounding box confidence threshold filter accuracy false positive

question: Can I process video files or use webcam streams in VisionTrack?
answer: VisionTrack supports live webcam video streams, uploaded video files (MP4, AVI, WEBM), static images, and a synthetic fallback stream mode when hardware is unavailable.
keywords: webcam video upload mp4 avi stream synthetic fallback

question: How are tracking IDs assigned to objects in VisionTrack?
answer: VisionTrack computes object bounding box centroids across consecutive frames and uses Euclidean distance minimization to maintain persistent track IDs (#1, #2, etc.).
keywords: tracking id persistent centroid euclidean distance assignment

question: Can I adjust the detection confidence threshold in VisionTrack?
answer: Yes, VisionTrack features a real-time confidence threshold slider allowing users to tune sensitivity between 10% and 90% on the fly.
keywords: confidence threshold slider sensitivity adjustment vision

question: Is my data stored securely in Nexus AI Lab?
answer: Yes, all data is stored locally in an isolated SQLite database instance with environment-variable configurable secrets and proper API sanitization.
keywords: security privacy local database sqlite secrets environment

question: What API endpoints are available for integration?
answer: Nexus AI Lab provides RESTful FastAPI endpoints for translation, FAQ search, chatbot queries, FAQ CRUD management, detection telemetry, and platform analytics.
keywords: api endpoints rest fastapi integration endpoints swagger docs
